findings.evidence: The only properties used are `IsIdempotentElem.iff_eq_zero_or_one` (Mathlib/Algebra/GroupWithZero/Idempotent.lean:37, needs `IsLeftCancelMulZero`) and `isReduced_of_injective` into `MonoidAlgebra K (Multiplicative (σ →₀ ℤ))`; both come from `instance [IsCancelAdd R] [IsDomain R] [Monoid A] [UniqueProds A] : IsDomain R[A]` (Mathlib/Algebra/MonoidAlgebra/NoZeroDivisors.lean:132), with `UniqueProds (Multiplicative (σ →₀ ℤ))` supplied by `instance {ι G} [AddZeroClass G] [UniqueSums G] : UniqueSums (ι →₀ G)` (Mathlib/Algebra/Group/UniqueProds/Basic.lean:470). `DiagonalizableGroup.baseChangeCoordinateRingIso` (TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/DiagonalizableGroup/BaseChange.lean:85-89) takes an arbitrary `(G : FGCommGrpCat.{u})`, and the repo's negative counterpart `not_isReduced_monoidAlgebra` (TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/GroupAlgebra/NotReduced.lean:100) is stated for a general `[CommMonoid G]`.
findings.fix: State both at `DiagonalizableGroup` level: `theorem geometricallyConnected_coordinateRing (k : Type u) [Field k] (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) [UniqueProds G] : geometricallyConnectedCommHopfAlgProperty k (DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateRing k G).obj` (likewise for reducedness), generalizing `coordinateRingBaseChangeEquiv` to arbitrary `G` — `DiagonalizableGroup.baseChangeCoordinateRingIso` is already stated for `(G : FGCommGrpCat.{u})`. Torus/SmoothConnected.lean:57,73 then applies it at `characterGroup (ULift.{u} (Fin n))` directly, so no wrapper is added.
findings.issue: `geometricallyConnected_coordinateRing` (line 62) and `geometricallyReduced_coordinateRing` (line 78) are stated only for `characterGroup σ` with `[Finite σ]`, but neither proof uses freeness or finite rank — both only need `MonoidAlgebra K G` to be a cancellative domain. The statement level is a strict special case of the diagonalizable-group statement with an identical proof, and it is the positive counterpart of a fact the repo already states for an arbitrary commutative group.

summary: The descent theorems are now at the right level (the algebraicity hypothesis is gone) and the split wrappers were correctly deleted. The remaining issue is that the two group-algebra facts are still stated only for the free character lattice although their proofs use nothing beyond `UniqueProds`.
